What is VBScript and where is it used?

VBScript (Visual Basic Scripting Edition) is a scripting language modeled on Visual Basic, developed by Microsoft. It uses the Variant data type for all variables.

Use cases:
- **Windows Script Host (WSH)** — automate Windows tasks
- **Classic ASP** — server-side web pages
- **Internet Explorer** — client-side scripting (legacy)

```vbscript
' hello.vbs
WScript.Echo "Hello, World!"
MsgBox "Hello from VBScript!"
```

```bash
cscript hello.vbs    ' console output
wscript hello.vbs    ' GUI dialog box
```

VBScript is dynamically typed — all variables are Variant and hold any data type.

How do variables, types, and string operations work in VBScript?

```vbscript
Option Explicit   ' require variable declarations (best practice!)

Dim name, age, pi, flag
name = "Alice"
age  = 30
pi   = 3.14159
flag = True

' VarType() returns subtype code
WScript.Echo VarType(42)       ' 2  (vbInteger/vbLong)
WScript.Echo VarType("hello")  ' 8  (vbString)
WScript.Echo VarType(True)     ' 11 (vbBoolean)
WScript.Echo VarType(3.14)     ' 5  (vbDouble)

' String operations
Dim s
s = "Hello, World!"
WScript.Echo Len(s)              ' 13
WScript.Echo UCase(s)            ' HELLO, WORLD!
WScript.Echo LCase(s)            ' hello, world!
WScript.Echo Left(s, 5)          ' Hello
WScript.Echo Right(s, 6)         ' World!
WScript.Echo Mid(s, 8, 5)        ' World
WScript.Echo InStr(s, "World")   ' 8
WScript.Echo Replace(s, "World", "VBScript")
WScript.Echo Trim("  hello  ")

' Type conversion
Dim n
n = CInt("42")
n = CDbl("3.14")
n = CStr(42)
n = CBool(1)

' Numeric functions
WScript.Echo Abs(-5)       ' 5
WScript.Echo Int(3.7)      ' 3  (floor)
WScript.Echo Round(3.567, 2)  ' 3.57
WScript.Echo Sqr(16)       ' 4
WScript.Echo Rnd()         ' random 0..1

' Formatting
WScript.Echo FormatNumber(3.14159, 2)  ' 3.14
WScript.Echo FormatCurrency(9.99)
```

How does control flow work in VBScript? Show If, Select Case, and loops.

```vbscript
Option Explicit
Dim x, i, day, score
x = 10

' If / ElseIf / Else
If x > 0 Then
    WScript.Echo "positive"
ElseIf x = 0 Then
    WScript.Echo "zero"
Else
    WScript.Echo "negative"
End If

' Single-line If
If x > 0 Then WScript.Echo "pos"

' Select Case
day = "Monday"
Select Case day
    Case "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"
        WScript.Echo "Weekday"
    Case "Saturday", "Sunday"
        WScript.Echo "Weekend"
    Case Else
        WScript.Echo "Unknown"
End Select

' Select Case with Is keyword (ranges)
score = 85
Select Case score
    Case Is >= 90 : WScript.Echo "A"
    Case Is >= 80 : WScript.Echo "B"
    Case Is >= 70 : WScript.Echo "C"
    Case Else     : WScript.Echo "F"
End Select

' For...Next
For i = 1 To 10
    WScript.Echo i
Next

' For...Next with Step
For i = 0 To 10 Step 2
    WScript.Echo i
Next

' For Each
Dim arr, item
arr = Array("apple", "banana", "cherry")
For Each item In arr
    WScript.Echo item
Next

' While...Wend
Dim n
n = 1
While n < 100
    n = n * 2
Wend

' Do While...Loop and Do Until...Loop
Dim count
count = 0
Do While count < 5
    count = count + 1
Loop

Do Until count = 10
    count = count + 1
Loop

' Exit For / Exit Do
For i = 1 To 10
    If i = 5 Then Exit For
    WScript.Echo i
Next
```

How do Subs, Functions, ByRef/ByVal, and arrays work in VBScript?

```vbscript
Option Explicit

' Sub — no return value
Sub Greet(name)
    WScript.Echo "Hello, " & name & "!"
End Sub

' Function — returns value
Function Add(a, b)
    Add = a + b     ' return by assigning to function name
End Function

Function Factorial(n)
    If n <= 1 Then
        Factorial = 1
    Else
        Factorial = n * Factorial(n - 1)
    End If
End Function

' ByRef (default) — changes affect caller
Sub SwapByRef(ByRef a, ByRef b)
    Dim temp
    temp = a
    a = b
    b = temp
End Sub

' ByVal — copy, original unchanged
Sub NoChangeByVal(ByVal x)
    x = 999  ' original unchanged
End Sub

' Call procedures
Call Greet("Alice")     ' with Call keyword
Greet "Bob"             ' without Call keyword
WScript.Echo Add(3, 4)         ' 7
WScript.Echo Factorial(5)      ' 120

Dim x, y
x = 10 : y = 20
SwapByRef x, y
WScript.Echo "x=" & x & " y=" & y   ' x=20 y=10

' Arrays
Dim arr(4)     ' 5 elements (0..4)
Dim arr2
arr2 = Array(10, 20, 30, 40, 50)
WScript.Echo arr2(0)          ' 10
WScript.Echo UBound(arr2)     ' 4
WScript.Echo LBound(arr2)     ' 0

' Dynamic array
Dim dynArr()
ReDim dynArr(2)
dynArr(0) = 10
ReDim Preserve dynArr(4)  ' resize, keep data
dynArr(3) = 40

' Split and Join
Dim parts
parts = Split("one,two,three", ",")
WScript.Echo parts(0)            ' one
WScript.Echo Join(parts, " - ")  ' one - two - three
```

How do FileSystemObject and file I/O work in VBScript?

```vbscript
Option Explicit
Dim fso, ts

' Create FileSystemObject
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

' Write to file
Set ts = fso.CreateTextFile("test.txt", True)  ' True=overwrite
ts.WriteLine "Hello, World!"
ts.WriteLine "Line 2"
ts.Close

' Read from file
Set ts = fso.OpenTextFile("test.txt", 1)  ' 1=ForReading
Do While Not ts.AtEndOfStream
    Dim line
    line = ts.ReadLine()
    WScript.Echo line
Loop
ts.Close

' Append to file
Set ts = fso.OpenTextFile("test.txt", 8, True)  ' 8=ForAppending
ts.WriteLine "Appended line"
ts.Close

' File/Directory operations
If fso.FileExists("test.txt") Then
    WScript.Echo "Size: " & fso.GetFile("test.txt").Size
End If

If Not fso.FolderExists("mydir") Then
    fso.CreateFolder "mydir"
End If

fso.CopyFile "test.txt", "test_copy.txt"
fso.MoveFile "test_copy.txt", "mydir\test_copy.txt"
fso.DeleteFile "test.txt"

' Path operations
WScript.Echo fso.GetFileName("C:\Users\Alice\file.txt")  ' file.txt
WScript.Echo fso.GetExtensionName("file.txt")            ' txt
WScript.Echo fso.GetParentFolderName("C:\Users\Alice\file.txt")

' Cleanup
Set ts = Nothing
Set fso = Nothing
```

How does error handling work in VBScript?

```vbscript
Option Explicit

' On Error Resume Next — suppress errors, check Err object
On Error Resume Next

Dim x
x = 1 / 0

If Err.Number <> 0 Then
    WScript.Echo "Error " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description
    Err.Clear       ' reset the error
End If

' On Error GoTo 0 — re-enable normal error handling
On Error GoTo 0

' Error handling pattern
Sub SafeDivide(a, b)
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim result
    result = a / b
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        WScript.Echo "Division error: " & Err.Description
        Err.Clear
        result = 0
    End If
    WScript.Echo "Result: " & result
End Sub

Call SafeDivide(10, 2)  ' Result: 5
Call SafeDivide(10, 0)  ' Division error: ...

' Custom error raising
Sub ValidateAge(age)
    On Error Resume Next
    If age < 0 Or age > 150 Then
        Err.Raise 1001, "ValidateAge", "Age must be 0-150"
    End If
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        WScript.Echo "Validation error: " & Err.Description
        Err.Clear
    End If
End Sub

Call ValidateAge(25)   ' OK
Call ValidateAge(-5)   ' Validation error

' Err object properties:
' Err.Number      — error code (0 = no error)
' Err.Description — error message
' Err.Source      — source of error
' Err.Clear       — reset error
' Err.Raise num, source, description — raise custom error
```

How does WScript Shell automation and Windows interaction work in VBScript?

```vbscript
Option Explicit

' WScript.Arguments — command line arguments
Dim args
Set args = WScript.Arguments
If args.Count > 0 Then
    WScript.Echo "Arg 0: " & args(0)
End If

' Named arguments (/name:value)
If args.Named.Exists("output") Then
    WScript.Echo "Output: " & args.Named("output")
End If

' WshShell — run programs, registry, environment
Dim shell
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")

' Run synchronously (wait = True)
Dim exitCode
exitCode = shell.Run("cmd /c dir", 0, True)
WScript.Echo "Exit code: " & exitCode

' Environment variables
Dim env
Set env = shell.Environment("PROCESS")
WScript.Echo env("PATH")
WScript.Echo env("USERPROFILE")
WScript.Echo env("COMPUTERNAME")

' Popup with timeout (-1=timeout, 1=OK, 2=Cancel, 6=Yes, 7=No)
Dim response
response = shell.Popup("Proceed?", 10, "Confirm", 4 + 32)
' 4=YesNo, 32=Question icon, 10=10 second timeout

' Registry access
shell.RegWrite "HKCU\SOFTWARE\MyApp\Setting", "Value", "REG_SZ"
Dim regVal
regVal = shell.RegRead("HKCU\SOFTWARE\MyApp\Setting")
WScript.Echo regVal
shell.RegDelete "HKCU\SOFTWARE\MyApp\Setting"

' Network object
Dim net
Set net = CreateObject("WScript.Network")
WScript.Echo net.ComputerName
WScript.Echo net.UserName

' Map network drive
net.MapNetworkDrive "Z:", "\\server\share"
net.RemoveNetworkDrive "Z:"

' Cleanup
Set shell = Nothing
Set net = Nothing
```
